runlog_check._doc: Run logs hold slot-level Jev decisions (one Choice across the noticed set), not per-product P(pick_up), so they cannot be reused directly; this compares their empirical pick|noticed rate with the surrogate's P(pick_up)*P(take) on the same events. Surrogate > run log is expected: the slot Choice makes products compete and allows 'walk past the whole shelf'.
